visual_connections.description: Client sends rendering request to API Gateway.
API Gateway forwards rendering request to Lambda frontend.
Lambda frontend pushes rendering jobs to SQS queue.
EC2 rendering engine pulls rendering jobs from SQS.
EC2 engine responds immediately with status to SQS response queue.
Lambda frontend polls response from SQS response queue.
Lambda returns playlist file link to user device.
EC2 engine uploads rendered video segments to S3.
User player requests video segments via CloudFront.
CloudFront fetches video segments from S3 origin.
Step Functions triggers Lambda scaling function every 15 seconds.
Lambda scaling function adjusts capacity on EC2 Auto Scaling group.
EC2 instances push metrics to CloudWatch.
Lambda scaling reads metrics from CloudWatch.
CloudWatch event triggers Lambda on 2-minute spot interruption notice.
Lambda tells specific EC2 instance to drain jobs and detach.
